subject: Simple relation conditions
notes: 8.8.4.2.1 item 9 'Two operands of class message-tag' (cite.py --check 8.8.4.2.1 OK, 9) and 8.8.4.2.14 (cite.py --check 8.8.4.2.14 OK): equality and inequality only, NULL admitted; two operands are equal when both are NULL or they name the same server name or requestor (MessageTag.SameParty), the message number taking no part.
